lines.jp:
爛れきった情交の疲労に蹌踉と、戻ってきた朔屋の足下のあまりの危うさに、さしもの智里も塩辛い顔をしてみせたとかなんだとか。
　なにか言いかける朔屋に、智里は己が額に手を当てる仕草で遮って、一旦食堂から姿を消して、程なくして戻ってきたその手には、軍用の払い下げと思しき水筒のぶら下げられたる。
lines.en:
Naomasa came staggering back, wrung out by the debauched encounter, his footing so perilous that even Tomosato reportedly pulled a sour face. 
Naomasa tried to speak, but Tomosato silenced him with a hand to his own brow, vanished from the mess hall, and soon returned with what looked like a military-surplus canteen dangling from one hand.

lines.jp: 「……まあ呑め。慌てるな、真水だ」
lines.en: ...Drink. Don't panic, it's fresh water.

lines.jp: 「でも……今の状況じゃ、真水は貴重なんじゃないのか？」
lines.en: But... isn't fresh water precious in the present situation?

lines.jp: 「そういう話もないでもねえが、てめえの有り様見てるとよ」
lines.en: That's not entirely wrong, but look at you.

lines.jp: 「どうやらあの姐さんにさんざか搾りとられてきたらしいや。かっさかさだぁ。水気を入れとけ少しは」
lines.en: Looks like that lady wrung you good and dry. You're parched. Get some water back in you.

lines.jp:
まるで泪の部屋での痴態一部始終を見透かされた覚えして、朔屋、差し出された水筒手に取り、蓋を外して口に運ぶ。喉を通る水は確かに若干饐えた感じはしたものの、智里の推察通り、あの部屋での濃密な空気に晒された体は確かに水分欲しており、体中にしみ込んでいくよう。
　入っていた水の半分ばかりを流し込んで、ようやく朔屋、飲み口を離す。
lines.en:
Feeling as though Tomosato had seen every last indignity in Namida's room, Naomasa took the canteen, uncapped it, and drank. The water tasted a little stale, but Tomosato had guessed correctly: the dense atmosphere of that room had left his body craving moisture, and the water seemed to seep into every part of him. 
Only after pouring down half the canteen did Naomasa lower it.

lines.jp:
「……っ。その……なんというか、
　なりゆきで」
lines.en:
...Well... How do I put this... 
One thing led to another.

lines.jp:
「お前がどこで女を食おうが女郎を買おうが、そんなこたぁどうでもいいんだよ。
　だがよ───飲んだら、口、拭え」
lines.en:
I don't give a damn where you bed a woman or buy a whore. 
But once you're done drinking--wipe your mouth.

lines.jp:
「紅は魔除けになるたぁ言うが、そこまで口の回りべっとりさせてちゃあ、エロ気が利きすぎだぁ。こっちまで脂くさくなりそうだぜ。
　話をすんにも、その後にしようや、な？」
lines.en:
They say rouge wards off evil, but smear that much around your mouth and the lechery starts working overtime. I can near smell the grease from here. 
We'll talk after you've cleaned it off, eh?

lines.jp: 慌てて朔屋、口元を拭えば、その手の甲にはべっとりと、泪の唇を彩っていた紅が伸びた。
lines.en: Naomasa hurriedly wiped his mouth. A thick streak of the rouge that had colored Namida's lips spread across the back of his hand.

lines.jp: 上甲板に上がれば四囲は相変わらず酒の海、沸き立つ酒気が夥しい、立っているだけでも酒精体中の毛穴からしみ込んで足元に来そうな。船内にいればいくらかは酒気も避けられるというのに、なぜわざわざと朔屋が殺し屋に訝しげに目問いすれば、智里それは無視して逆に首尾を問う。
lines.en: On the upper deck, the sea was alcohol as ever, its fumes boiling up in such profusion that merely standing there seemed enough to let the spirit seep through every pore and go straight to his legs. Inside the ship they could avoid at least some of it. Naomasa asked the assassin with a puzzled look why they had come out here, but Tomosato ignored the question and demanded his report instead.

lines.jp:
「そんで、どうだった、首尾は？
　あったんだろ、真珠」
lines.en:
So, how did it go? 
There was a pearl, right?

lines.jp: 「……ああ。あるにはあった、というか出てきたというか。ともかく───駄目だああ」
lines.en: ...Yeah. It was there--or it came out, anyway. Whatever happened--it's all gone wrong!

lines.jp: 朔屋、そもそもの目的の真珠の行方を思い出し、頭を抱える。確かに、智里の言う通りも真珠はあったとも、あったけれどもそれは今、己の腹の中だという事実。
lines.en: Naomasa remembered what had become of the pearl and clutched his head. Tomosato had been right: the pearl existed. It existed, certainly--and now it was in Naomasa's belly.

lines.jp: 「泪さんに飲まされてしまったんだ」
lines.en: Namida made me swallow it.

lines.jp:
「飲まされたぁ？　
　女ァ抱いてきたに飽きたらず、呑んできたとけつかる。どこの女王様だてめぇは」
lines.en:
Made you swallow her? 
Not content with bedding the woman, you went and devoured her too? What kind of queen does that make you?

lines.jp:
「……面目次第も……。
　あ。君もしかして、その長物で僕の腹を切開して取り出そうとか考えてないだろうな。
　そんな事したって、もうきっと消化液に浸食されてるぞ、故売屋だって買い取ってくれないぞ」
lines.en:
...I have no excuse... 
Wait. You're not thinking of using that long blade to cut open my stomach and take it out, are you? 
It must be corroding in digestive juices already. Even a fence wouldn't buy it now.

lines.jp: 「アホくさい。お前の腸かっ捌いたってなにが面白い。お前の酒まみれの肝なんざ、それこそ薬種商だって買い取りゃしねえ」
lines.en: Don't be an ass. What fun would there be in splitting your guts open? That liquor-soaked liver of yours wouldn't fetch a price from an apothecary.

lines.jp: 意地悪くせせら笑う智里だったが、この男、本格的に自分の仕事を忘れているのではないかと疑わしい。が、すぐさますとんと落ち着いて智里は、懐手に頷いた。
lines.en: Tomosato gave a nasty little sneer, though one had to wonder whether the man had altogether forgotten his profession. Then, just as quickly, he settled, folded his hands inside his robe, and nodded.

lines.jp:
「───ま、それでもいいんだ多分。
　腹ン中にあろうが身に着けていようがどっちでも。おらいっちょ試してみ？」
lines.en:
--Well, that'll probably do. 
In your belly or on your person, shouldn't make much difference. Here, give it a try.

lines.jp: と無造作に、抜く手もみせずに舷側に一閃、その剣閃の速さもさりながら、朔屋にはそれまで智里が一体どこに刀を提げていたのかも見えず。無手だったのだ確かにそれまでは。分厚い舷側がたやすく断ち割られ、海へと開かれた時に朔屋が抱いた悪い予感は直後に証明された。
lines.en: Casually, without so much as showing the draw, Tomosato sent one flash across the gunwale. The stroke was impossibly fast, but stranger still, Naomasa had never seen where he carried the sword at all. Until that instant, his hands had unquestionably been empty. The thick gunwale split with ease, opening the way to the sea--and Naomasa's sudden foreboding was proved correct a moment later.

lines.jp: 智里が朔屋の腰を蹴ったぐり、叩き落としたのだ容赦なく。
lines.en: Tomosato planted a kick in Naomasa's waist and knocked him overboard without a trace of mercy.

lines.jp: 「待っ、莫っ」
lines.en: Wait, you id--

lines.jp: 待ても莫迦も言いきれず、落ちていくが酒の赤い水面へ、真っ逆様に悲鳴の緒も長く曳いて。
lines.en: He could finish neither 'wait' nor 'idiot' before plunging headfirst toward the red surface, the long thread of his scream trailing after him.

lines.jp:
（ごばっ！　ばばばば莫迦あの人殺し、
　斬る代わりに溺れ死なすつもり───
　ごぼごばごぼごぼぼ───っ）
lines.en:
(Gwab! Y-you murderous idiot! 
Instead of cutting me, you're going to drown me-- 
Gblblbl--!)

lines.jp:
（死んだ、今度こそ死んだ、
　苦しい、息が、
　ボコボコボコボコボコボコ───）
lines.en:
(I'm dead, truly dead this time! 
It hurts, I can't breathe-- 
Bubblebubblebubble--!)

lines.jp: （ああ、なんだってこんな事に───）
lines.en: (Why has this happened to me--?)

lines.jp:
（苦しい苦しい、がば、がぼぼぼっ、
　溺れ死ぬのなんて厭だ、ひどすぎる───）
lines.en:
(It hurts, it hurts! Glub, glub! 
I don't want to drown--this is too cruel!)

lines.jp:
真に溺死の危機に直面した者には、そこまで悠長に恐怖していられる暇などあるまい。
　実際───
lines.en:
Anyone in genuine danger of drowning would hardly have time to fear it at such leisure. 
And indeed--

lines.jp: 温く体にまとわりつく葡萄酒の海の中、朔屋、必死に四肢振り回してもがきにもがく。もがけどしかし息は続かず水面は見えず、ついに堪えかねて口を開けたところで流れ込む赤い液体、瞬く間に肺の中まで浸されて、遂に朔屋、呼吸もできずに、海の藻屑───
lines.en: In the warm sea of wine clinging around him, Naomasa thrashed every limb in desperate struggle. Yet his breath would not last and the surface was nowhere in sight. At last endurance failed; he opened his mouth, and red liquid rushed in, flooding his lungs in an instant. At last Naomasa would become mere wreckage beneath the sea--

lines.jp:
とはいかなかった。
　いかに人の肺は液体からでも酸素を得られるとはいっても、魚の鰓の様にはいかず、息続くわけないはずなのに、
　どういう奇跡なのか、朔屋は水中で呼吸が可能となっていたのだ。そればかりでなく、動くのも自在で、水の中の抵抗も上下感覚の混乱もなく、いともあっさりと水面に浮上する。
lines.en:
--or not. 
Whatever minute oxygen human lungs might draw from liquid, they are no fish's gills; it should never have been enough to keep him breathing. 
Yet by some miracle Naomasa could breathe underwater. Not only that: he could move freely, without drag or any confusion of up and down, and rose to the surface with absurd ease.
--Huh?

lines.jp:
赤い水面に上がってみれば、肺より葡萄酒吐き出される感触はやや気分に障るものの、もちろん、息も普通に続く。
　不思議に頭を捻りつつ周囲見渡せば、間近に信天翁号の船体があり、海面まで垂らされたのは縄梯子。手に取り上らんと見上げてみれば、こちらは見下ろしている殺し屋の顔。朔屋、全身酒に夥しく濡れて上甲板に戻るのだった。
lines.en:
When he broke the red surface, the sensation of wine leaving his lungs was unpleasant, but his breathing continued normally. 
Still baffled, he looked around. The Albatross's hull was close by, with a rope ladder lowered to the water. Naomasa caught it, looked up, and found the assassin staring down at him. Drenched head to foot in alcohol, he climbed back onto the upper deck.

lines.jp: 「で、どうだったい、海水浴は」
lines.en: So, how was your swim?

lines.jp: 「どうもなにも、いったいどうなっちまったんだ、僕の体は。海の中だというのに、息は続くし苦しくもならない。ああ、そうか、僕はいよいよ魚になっちまったんだなぁ」
lines.en: What do you mean, how? What's happened to my body? I'm under the sea, but I can breathe and it doesn't even hurt. Ah, of course. I've finally turned into a fish.

lines.jp: 「いや、そういうのは他にまかせておけよ」
lines.en: No, leave the fish business to someone else.

lines.jp: しかし、朔屋は己の変化に頭が回る。この際、このふざけた殺し屋でもかまわない、誰か僕にまっとうな説明をしてくれと縋らん気持ちで智里を見れば、平素のにやけた顔もどこへやら、顎に手当てて思案顔。
lines.en: Naomasa could think of nothing but his transformation. He turned a pleading look on Tomosato--at this point, even this preposterous assassin would do; someone, please, give him a sensible explanation. But Tomosato's habitual grin had vanished. One hand against his chin, he was deep in thought.

lines.jp: 「……水の中を酸素を取り出すだけでなく、人体を水中に適応させるような構造変換も行っているのか、あるいは単に体表面に力場を発生させて水の侵入を防いでいるのか」
lines.en: ...Either it extracts oxygen from the water and restructures the human body for underwater adaptation, or it merely generates a force field over the body's surface to keep the water out.

lines.jp: 朔屋には意味も通らぬことをぶつぶつと。さてはこの男、何か知ってると朔屋がその呟きに耳傾けようとしたところで、
lines.en: He muttered things beyond Naomasa's comprehension. Certain now that the man knew something, Naomasa bent his ear toward the mumbling--

lines.jp: 「ま、細かい仕組みなんぞ、俺だって知るかい」
lines.en: Ah, hell, I don't know how the fine details work either.

lines.jp: と、あっさり己の思索、ぶん投げる。
lines.en: --only for Tomosato to toss his entire line of thought away without ceremony.

lines.jp: 「とにもかくにも、これでてめえがこの酒の海の中まで入っていけるってこった」
lines.en: Anyhow, now we know you can go down into this sea of booze.

lines.jp:
「でもだって、息ができるのはいいとしても、
　僕は一体何処にどこに行って何をすればいいんだぁ……」
lines.en:
But even if I can breathe, 
where in the world am I supposed to go, and what am I supposed to do there...?

lines.jp:
「そこまで俺が知るかいよ。
　まあ行き先は、
　てめえの腹ン中の真珠に訊けや」
lines.en:
How the hell should I know? 
As for where you're going-- 
ask the pearl in your belly.

lines.jp: 「後はまあ、なるようになんだろうぜ」
lines.en: After that, things'll work themselves out somehow.
